newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France makes no change at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France makes no change at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France made no net drain or injection at a securities repurchase tender held on Monday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Tuesday.
It accepted bids for 30.1 billion francs in new liquidity, the same as the 30.1 billion leaving the market on Tuesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on December 10.
The Bank of France said it allocated 9.1 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 2.6 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 21.0 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 9.3 percent of this demand.
